caption:
Test all four rates in one line.

Type 64000(1 + [0.052, 0.06, 0.066, 0.266])^4 into Desmos. You get four populations at once; pick the one closest to 81,000.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Put all four answer choices in brackets and Desmos checks them at once.
